text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Ah, whoops. I just cameout for a little run in the mountains. Ididn't mean to stay out this late.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey... what's that light up ahead?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: This is... the sanctuary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Who are you, lady?!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: In the sanctuary, wear holy robes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha... What da heck is going on?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross. Or should I call you,<n>Nishikino
Cross?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
I will look into your soul. Who is the<n>Umamusume
whose spirit most<n>resembles yours?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What? Well that's a weird question.<n>Whose spirit is
like mine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, I guess? She's ambitious, like<n>me. I coulda
told ya that, though.

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: Beyond the surface, the one most like<n>you is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hi, Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. You and I... We are alike.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What?! Rudolf?! What do we have in<n>common?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're totally different in every way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You know, I think we're pretty similar.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're really speedy across the<n>finish line, but
deep down, you and I<n>share the same competitive
spirit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You too, Teio?! Are ya outta your<n>mind?!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
And then there is she who goes by<n>the name "Dark
Lord of Destruction."

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
But the Umamusume whose spirit<n>most resembles
yours is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hayahide?! You and me are meant to<n>be similar?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We are. You and I are like two sides<n>of an equation.
That is to say...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We are united by the equal sign. It's<n>simple
arithmetic. Symmetry of the<n>soul.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Da heck?! Quit speaking gibberish! I<n>don't know a
thing about equations<n>and math and all that stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's Oguri who's like me! And maybe<n>Inari, too!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
You only scratch the surface. The soul<n>cannot be
measured in such shallow<n>metrics.

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: Accept yourself. This is who you<n>really are!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! You gotta be kidding me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(This is so annoying! I don't wanna<n>believe what
she's tellin' me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(My head! I can't get it out of my<n>head! So now
what?)
choice_data_list: Do some vigorous training to forget about it.
Run away from the mountain as fast as you can!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good idea. I'll do a hard<n>workout when I get
back.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll forget aaall about it. This has<n>to be a
dream. Some kinda stupid<n>dream!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is running differently<n>today. She
almost looks as if she's<n>running away from
something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you in the middle of a training<n>session?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt, but would you mind<n>if I used one
half of the track for my<n>practice?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-y-you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There you go again with your math!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tamamo?! What are you talking<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! No matter how far I run, I<n>can't get away
from you and your<n>big-brain equations! My head!
My<n>head! We're not the saaame!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What?! My head's not that much<n>bigger than
yours? Tamamo, wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo runs away as fast as her<n>legs can carry
her. She's abnormally<n>fast and her face looks pale.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. Better not waste<n>any more time
here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I needa leave before I get too<n>wrapped up in this
nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! Get me outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... How was my time on theramps?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But what?
choice_data_list: You were faster on the way down.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You took my time on the way<n>down? What's
the point in that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm... that does make sense, though.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just, you could say I got<n>some ramp
practice on a mountain<n>the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty intense, but I think I got<n>the hang of
runnin' downhill from it.<n>At least somethin' good
came from<n>that mess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not clear what happened to her,<n>but it seems
like she managed to gain<n>something from a bad
experience.
